newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were firmer alongside rising values for cracked material, but the market remains well supplied with Russian barrels, traders said.
An E-4 from Klaipeda, with a maximum two percent water content, was heard offered at mean/mean/mean +$4 cif NWE, while another with slightly higher water was heard offered at +$2.50.
An NWE refiner was heard to have bought an M-40 cargo from Tallinn at mean/mean +$10 cif NWE.
Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady to firmer, with offers pegged at around $135 fob NWE.
Buyers were around $3 a tonnne lower than that.
